notes: The 259NP is an AC-motor InfinitiPro dryer released in 2013. The 1875 W, 110 to 125 V, three heat and two speed settings, ionizing function and ALCI come from the booklet for the 259 line and rate the whole dryer; the heating element and switch positions are from iFixit guides for the 259NP.

gaps: The booklet (IB 9854, file 259RNY) is headed '259 Models' and prints no model letters (cover rendered and read); the 259NP is matched to it by the shared 259 prefix. iFixit's 259NP device page lists the same features (AC motor, cold shot button, 3 heat and 2 speed settings).
1875 W and 110 to 125 V are the dryer's ratings (booklet operating guide and instructions), so they are not set on the motor.
The booklet says 'AC motor' and gives no brush or winding type; motor_universal is the closest part type, not a stated fact.
The booklet puts the ALCI test button on the plug and describes a reset button; the key stays alci_device because no plug part type fits.
No part type exists for an ioniser; transformer_hv is the nearest high-voltage type and is not a claim that it holds a transformer.
An iFixit comment on the 25675 guide says the part the guide calls a capacitor is an ion generator. That comment is not a teardown and is not claimed.
The iFixit guides give no watts, volts, switch codes or part numbers. Guide 25662 is flagged for missing steps; it was read, not cited.
method: Conair Infiniti Pro 259 Models instruction booklet IB 9854 (Conair library PDF, file 259RNY), read as text and rendered; the two-page spread is set in columns and the lines used are clear.

iFixit 259NP guides read through the guide API: Heat Shield 25668 (with its back panel and fan motor prerequisite steps), Hot/Cold Button 25675, Fan Motor 25662, Cold Shot Button 25677; and the 259NP device page. CC BY-NC-SA: facts and links only.
A Walmart listing for the 259NP showed a bot check and was not used; Conair product pages tried for 259NP and 259BDNRY returned HTTP 404.

comps.spec: AC motor; the booklet's feature panel calls it a powerful AC motor.
Heating element that is pulled out of a heat shield once the back panel and fan motor are removed.
comps.loc: In the heat shield, which lifts out with the fan motor and wiring

comps.spec: Switches with three buttons on wires. In the hot/cold button guide the middle button is the one desoldered and replaced.
Automatic safety device that switches the dryer or just the heat off when blocked intake vents make it overheat. The booklet says to unplug and let it cool 10 to 15 minutes.
ALCI (appliance leakage circuit interrupter) with a test button on the plug and a reset button. It makes the dryer inoperable under abnormal conditions such as immersion in water.
Ionizing function (Ionic Technology) that the booklet says generates a cloud of negative ions.
